mapper.select: SELECT /* getPopularBookList */ COALESCE(B.BOOK_TITL, '') AS TITLE , COALESCE(B.BOOK_ATHR, '') AS AUTHOR , COALESCE(B.BOOK_PUBL, '') AS PUBLISHER , COALESCE(B.BOOK_ISBN, '') AS ISBN , COALESCE(B.BOOK_CVIM, '') AS IMAGE , COALESCE(B.BOOK_DESC, '') AS DESCRIPTION , COALESCE(DATE_FORMAT(B.PUBL_DATE, '%Y%m%d'), '') AS PUBDATE , P.REPORT_COUNT , ROUND(AVG(CAST(G.REPT_GRDE AS UNSIGNED)), 1) AS RATING_AVERAGE FROM ( SELECT R.BOOK_NUMB AS BOOK_NUMB , COUNT(DISTINCT R.USER_NUMB) AS REPORT_COUNT , MAX(R.REGI_DATE) AS LATEST_REPORT_DATE FROM TM_REPORT R WHERE R.REGI_DATE >= #{periodStart} AND R.REGI_DATE < #{nextPeriodStart} GROUP BY R.BOOK_NUMB ORDER BY REPORT_COUNT DESC , LATEST_REPORT_DATE DESC , R.BOOK_NUMB LIMIT 10 ) P JOIN TM_BKINFO B ON B.BOOK_NUMB = P.BOOK_NUMB LEFT JOIN TM_REPORT G ON G.BOOK_NUMB = P.BOOK_NUMB AND G.REPT_STAT != #{reptStatRead} GROUP BY B.BOOK_NUMB , B.BOOK_TITL , B.BOOK_ATHR , B.BOOK_PUBL , B.BOOK_ISBN , B.BOOK_CVIM , B.BOOK_DESC , B.PUBL_DATE , P.REPORT_COUNT , P.LATEST_REPORT_DATE ORDER BY P.REPORT_COUNT DESC , P.LATEST_REPORT_DATE DESC , P.BOOK_NUMB
